meta.name: pdf-processing-pro
meta.description: Production-ready PDF processing with forms, tables, OCR, validation, and batch operations. Use when working with complex PDF workflows in production environments, processing large volumes of PDFs, or requiring robust error handling and validation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量处理PDF表单、表格、OCR和验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要自动化处理大量PDF文档
copy.tagline_en: Process PDF forms, tables, OCR, and validation in batch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to automate processing of large volumes of PDFs

howto.what: 让Claude具备PDF处理能力:可从PDF提取文本、分析并填写表单、提取表格、对扫描件做OCR识别,支持批量处理和结果校验,脚本带错误处理、日志和命令行界面。
howto.when: 当你要求处理复杂PDF工作流、批量处理大量PDF,或需要可靠的错误处理和数据验证时触发。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to handle PDFs: extract text, analyze and fill forms, extract tables, OCR scanned documents, process batches, and validate results. Scripts include error handling, logging, and a CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to work with complex PDF workflows, process large volumes of PDFs, or need robust error handling and validation.

Extract the tables in this report as CSV
Batch-process all PDFs in the invoices folder for text extraction
say_en.note: Processes each file and reports success or failure
